pkgmetadata.longdescription: zeta is a language server that treats a directory of Typst files as a note graph. It resolves #link("...") calls between notes to provide go-to-definition (follow a link), find-references (backlinks), workspace-symbol search over all notes, broken-link diagnostics, and a live force-directed graph view served to the browser over WebSocket. Used on zentoo to add a Zettelkasten interconnect layer over the papis/Typst research library.
